how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-ironforge-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:637:obj:0: Deliver Sully Balloo's Letter to Sara Balloo.
rows.quest:637:details:0: The waterlogged and war-torn envelope dissolves in your hands, leaving you with a few pages of a letter in your grasp, written with painstaking care.
rows.quest:637:details:1: BThe letter is addressed to a Mrs. Sara Balloo of ⟦E1⟧ and begins, "My dear Sara...."
rows.quest:637:completion:0: You say you saw my Sully pinned beneath the icy waters? Say it isn't so!
rows.quest:637:completion:1: BLet me read what he wrote....
rows.quest:683:obj:0: Take Sara Balloo's note to King Magni Bronzebeard of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:683:details:0: ⟦1⟧, I have but a small request to ask of you.
rows.quest:683:details:1: BTake this note I have prepared to our great monarch of ⟦E1⟧, King Magni Bronzebeard. 'Tis a small task to ask of one such as yourself, someone who has shown great valor to the cause of the ⟦E2⟧ thus far.
rows.quest:683:details:2: BFor me to go before the King in my grief-ridden state would not serve the purpose of my cause. Surely you understand.
rows.quest:683:completion:0: It will take but a moment for me to peruse this letter...
rows.quest:686:obj:0: King Magni Bronzebeard wants you to speak with Grand ⟦E3⟧ Marblesten.
rows.quest:686:details:0: I do not expect good dwarves like Mrs. Balloo to understand why the travesties of war must be endured for the greater good of our people. The loss of her husband, and the loss of every dwarf that fights in the name of the ⟦E2⟧, weighs heavy on my soul.
rows.quest:686:details:1: BWhile I cannot bring her husband back from the ⟦E4⟧, I can pay tribute to him.
rows.quest:686:details:2: BI am going to commission a memorial to Sully Balloo to be built by Grand ⟦E3⟧ Marblesten.
rows.quest:686:details:3: BSend word to him now, ⟦2⟧. You shall be custodian of my bidding.
rows.quest:686:completion:0: So King Magni Bronzebeard himself sent ye?
rows.quest:686:completion:1: BMy, my! This must be important!
rows.quest:689:obj:0: Grand ⟦E3⟧ Marblesten of ⟦E1⟧ wants 5 pieces of Alterac Granite.
rows.quest:689:details:0: So our good King would like a memorial built in honor of a soldier named Sully Balloo? And you say the poor chap died during the Thandol Span tragedy?
rows.quest:689:details:1: BBah, will there ever be peace on ⟦E5⟧?
rows.quest:689:details:2: BNonetheless, any commission from the King is of utmost importance. To build a truly epic and lasting piece I want to work with one of the finest stones available. ⟦E6⟧ to Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad and gather for me some Alterac Granite.
rows.quest:689:completion:0: Perfect! Better than I could have imagined!
rows.quest:689:completion:1: BAnd I have quite an imagination you know...
rows.quest:700:details:0: Ah, such fine stone comes from Lordaeron. Such a shame the land is in such shambles.
rows.quest:700:details:1: BBut the Memorial came out quite well! I should think the King will be most pleased with it.
rows.quest:700:details:2: BNow if you will, please send word to His Majesty that the Memorial is complete as requested.
rows.quest:700:completion:0: The granite seems but a small token compared to a great dwarf's life. But no dwarf shall last on this planet for eternity.
rows.quest:700:completion:1: BLet us just hope that the memorial stands as a reminder to those who will trod the great ⟦E5⟧ of the future. Lest we not forget it is for them that brave soldiers such as Sully Balloo so valiantly gave their lives.
rows.quest:707:obj:0: Speak with Prospector ⟦E7⟧ at ⟦E7⟧'s Excavation Site in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:707:details:0: ⟦3⟧. I received reports from Prospector ⟦E7⟧ at his excavation site in ⟦E8⟧--he needs some legwork done concerning another of our excavations.
rows.quest:707:details:1: BI don't have more details than that, but if you want to stretch your legs then go speak with ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:707:completion:0: So Stormpike sent you, did he? Good.
rows.quest:707:completion:1: BI have a big task for you...
rows.quest:1019:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E9⟧ Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of ⟦E10⟧ about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1019:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of ⟦E11⟧! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of ⟦E12⟧ and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
rows.quest:1019:details:2: BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch ⟦E9⟧ in ⟦E10⟧, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
rows.quest:1019:completion:0: What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, ⟦4⟧? Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. By all means, the welfare of ⟦E10⟧ - nay, all of ⟦E13⟧ - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.
rows.quest:1019:completion:1: BThe fools in ⟦E14⟧ waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?
rows.quest:1453:details:0: There's work to be done in ⟦E15⟧, ⟦5⟧. It's an atrocious place, befouled by centaur and other nasties. But if you're looking for a good week's honest work, then head there, meet with Kreldig Ungor, and tell him I sentcha.
rows.quest:1453:details:1: BYou can find him holed up at Nijel's Point--it's a little cozy camp hidden in the mountains of northern ⟦E15⟧. Just head east if you enter from the ⟦E16⟧. It's easy to miss, so be on the lookout.
rows.quest:1453:completion:0: Glad to see the Reclaimers aren't in short supply of work, or adventurers willing to help out.
rows.quest:1453:completion:1: BI'm Kreldig, ⟦6⟧. You've made a smart move helpin' out the Reclaimers. Everyone needs something these days: they've lost a family heirloom, a magic item, a loved one. You never can tell. But with the Reclaimers around, there's no reason, for the right price, everyone can't find what they've lost.
rows.quest:2039:details:0: We've lost contact with Bingles! He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. I just know he's gone and blown himself up.
rows.quest:2039:details:1: BHe was last seen flying over the Loch. Perhaps you can investigate, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:2039:completion:0: So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...
rows.quest:2039:completion:1: BNevermind that, I need your assistance! Nay! The movement needs your assistance!
rows.quest:2041:obj:0: Speak with Shoni the Shilent in ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:2041:details:0: Perhaps... Perhaps you can help us in the battle for Gnomeregan.
rows.quest:2041:details:1: BIn ⟦E17⟧ you will find the commander of our underground assault crew, Shoni the Shilent. Shoni needs assistance with her gyrodrillmatic excavationators.
rows.quest:2041:details:2: BYou will probably find her amongst the dwarves in ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:2041:completion:0: Do you bring word from central command?
rows.quest:2439:obj:0: Take your reward voucher to Dinita Stonemantle in the Vault of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2439:details:0: This object is an incredible find. The ancient Titans, or the Creators as these discs refer to them as, are the link to our enchanted creation, if the lore stored in here is correct! We'll need to invest as much research time into this as possible.
rows.quest:2439:details:1: BAs for you, heroic ⟦9⟧, take this voucher to Dinita Stonemantle at the vault. It grants you what I think is a fitting for such a tremendous find!
rows.quest:2439:details:2: BReturn to me directly when you are ready; there is much more to do for the Explorers' League!
rows.quest:2439:completion:0: As yes, a voucher from the Explorers' League... and quite the valuable one, might I add.
rows.quest:2439:completion:1: BThe Explorers' League lends me the authority to offer you a choice in your compensation directly from their vault. You are to receive this item, and you may choose between five superior healing potions or five greater mana potions as your reward.
rows.quest:2946:obj:0: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in ⟦E12⟧ and look for clues as to the connection between the two.
rows.quest:2946:details:0: We want you to take the miniature discs you found to the sealed gates of Uldum. We... we aren't sure what will happen when you do this.
rows.quest:2946:details:1: BThis sounds risky, sure, we acknowledge that. It might, however, do nothing. You might need to use the discs on something. Perhaps the doors unlock when you have the discs in your possession. Be open to try anything, and be ready for anything to happen.
rows.quest:2946:details:2: BWhen you've found out what happens, return to ⟦E1⟧. We'll have a lot to analyze when you're done!
rows.quest:2946:completion:0: As you touch the pedestal, the miniature discs from Uldaman hum and glow in your backpack. A familiar feeling tingle washes over your hands, as the image of another Stone Watcher springs to life in front of the gates of Uldum.
rows.quest:2946:completion:1: B"Salutations. I am a guardian of entry. The discs that have been used for access are missing the correct entry discs, the Plates of Uldum. Please incorporate these plates with the disc structure and repeat your access sequencing. Thank you."
rows.quest:2948:obj:0: Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Talvash del Kissel in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2948:details:0: Listen ⟦10⟧, that ring is yours, sure... but I can make you a better one! That design, like I said, is really simple. I am a lot more skilled now, and for the mere fee of thirty silver coins I'll spruce it up for you! Well, a little more than thirty, actually...
rows.quest:2948:details:1: BI'm in a tight spot right now; all my material stock is all dried up. If you bring me a bar of silver and a moss agate, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will give it a little more pizzazz!
rows.quest:2948:completion:0: Ah, exactly what I needed! Someday, when I find myself out of this hole that I am unjustly in, I will make for you, for EVERYONE the finest trinkets in all of ⟦E5⟧! Until then, thanks for being a sport about the reagents. I'd normally charge ten times what I have charged you for a ring of this quality...
rows.quest:2948:completion:1: BSpeaking of rings, here's your new one!
rows.quest:2963:obj:0: Speak with Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers within ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2963:details:0: Greetings once again, ⟦11⟧! Your discovery inside Uldaman has set the Explorers' League abuzz with excitement. The League has been working to unlock the secrets of the miniature platinum discs you found. Your fortuitous arrival here in the Hall allows me to share with you that we are quite possibly on to something!
rows.quest:2963:details:1: BHistorian Karnik has uncovered some important clues as to the true origins of the Valley of the Watchers in the ⟦E12⟧ desert. He would like to speak with you as soon as possible!
rows.quest:2963:completion:0: I am glad you're maintaining your interest in exploration, ⟦12⟧! With your natural talent and moxie, we could crack open secrets that we never thought were possible!
rows.quest:2963:completion:1: BThe Discs of Norgannon in Uldaman were a repository of vast information; you were only permitted to access the top layers, as it were, of the information stored there. The Creators were rumored to have more repositories located throughout ⟦E5⟧. This now brings us to Uldum...
rows.quest:2964:obj:0: Speak with High Explorer Magellas in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2964:details:0: Well ⟦13⟧... we seem to be at a temporary dead end here. We know what we need - the Plates of Uldum - but we have no idea where they might be. We'll need to do quite a bit of research on this to come up with a solid plan of attack. I have a couple ideas where to start looking; I have high hopes that soon, we'll be asking you to head out and recover them.
rows.quest:2964:details:1: BThe High Explorer needs to be informed on this, ⟦14⟧; no doubt, he also wants to thank you personally for once again aiding the League.
rows.quest:2964:completion:0: We're all in agreement then - the best plan of attack is putting this on hold until we can narrow down the areas where these plates might lie hidden. You've brought us this far ⟦15⟧, and I hope you will be the one to head back in to the field to unlock Uldum for us all!
rows.quest:2964:completion:1: BAllow me to give you this honorarium in the meantime; this should cover any expenses you've encountered in assisting us, and a little something extra. Be sure to check back with us soon... Uldum beckons!
rows.quest:2977:details:0: You access the pedestal again; the platinum discs suddenly appear once more in your backpack.
rows.quest:2977:details:1: BWith the knowledge of the stone watcher learned and the discs returned to your possession, the time has come to return to ⟦E1⟧ and inform the Explorers' League of your discovery.
rows.quest:2977:completion:0: You were missing some discs? Interestingly enough, it seems that the discs of Norgannon are only parts of the complete set - like keys on a key ring, if you will.
rows.quest:2977:completion:1: BIf we can find the Plates of Uldum, then we could actually access the Uldum complex itself! Imagine actually exploring the place where the Creators worked without having to bring a huge shovel!
rows.quest:2977:completion:2: BNot that there's anything wrong with shovels... or digging...
rows.quest:3201:obj:0: Take the Proof of Deed back to Mountaineer Pebblebitty.
rows.quest:3201:details:0: I can't believe Pebblebitty doubted the authenticity of the horn. Between you and me, I think she's just jealous. I know she really wanted to kill that beast herself, what with the 'incident' and all.
rows.quest:3201:details:1: BSo you need a proof of deed? After the contribution you just made to the museum, it won't be a problem.
rows.quest:3201:details:2: B<Curator Thorius begins to fill out a large document.>
rows.quest:3201:details:3: BThere we go! You can take that back to Pebblebitty.
rows.quest:3201:completion:0: I don't know how someone as weak as you overcame Margol, but a deal is a deal. Here is the key.
rows.quest:3201:completion:1: BIf anything happens to you after this, it will be your own fault.
rows.quest:3371:obj:0: Return to the ⟦E18⟧ and find Dorius's archaeology unit.
rows.quest:3371:details:0: There is an empty, vacuous hole, where my heart used to be, ⟦16⟧. The loss of Dorius is not one that I will soon recover from. I must see his final wish through - the perpetrators of this cold blooded murder must be brought to justice.
rows.quest:3371:details:1: BReturn to the ⟦E18⟧ and fulfill his last request: Free his men. The Dark Iron dwarves force their slaves to work in a sweltering mine called the Slag Pits. Search there for Dorius' men.
rows.quest:3371:completion:0: Forget about me, help the others.
rows.quest:3448:details:0: I've recently been handed the responsibility of investigating ⟦E19⟧--a once beautiful area the elves called home. This would be back when they practiced magic. It's now a more dangerous place than it is beautiful, but that doesn't stop us from turning over every stone for answers to our past.
rows.quest:3448:details:1: BA companion of mine named Tymor offered to help me investigate the area since he takes a particular interest in such things.
rows.quest:3448:details:2: BHe owns a small place to the right of the Hall of Mysteries here in the city.
rows.quest:3448:completion:0: Ah, Karnik sent you, did he? I expected to hear from him soon. I've discovered such wonderful things about ⟦E19⟧.. I know night elves have incredible life spans, but everyone forgets some of the more... unfortunate events in their lives sometimes. That's not meant as a criticism, just an observation.
rows.quest:3448:completion:1: BLong ago, there were cities created by the elves filled with knowledge about magic and other lost arts. Being a student of such things, I started my investigation. What I found was quite thrilling.
rows.quest:3449:obj:0: Using the Drawing Kit, make rubbings of the Rune of Beth'Amara, the Rune of Jin'yael, the Rune of Markri, and the Rune of Sael'hai before heading to the small island off of the southern peninsula of ⟦E19⟧ and signaling Pilot Xiggs Fuselighter to pick them up.
rows.quest:3449:details:0: Magic was once as revered as ⟦E20⟧ herself to some elves. Some of their most powerful mages created runes and tablets citing rules of the arcane and insights into their findings. They would leave these for all to ponder in public places.
rows.quest:3449:details:1: BI would very much like rubbings of these runes from the Ruins of Eldarath. I have a kit for you to make the rubbings with, but it will be up to you to find them. Be careful though, the Explorer's League isn't the only one interested in Eldarath.
rows.quest:3449:completion:0: Good to see you safe and sound, ⟦17⟧. I hope things weren't too tough for you.
rows.quest:3449:completion:1: BI'll get these to Tymor right away. He'll be thrilled to take a look at these things.
rows.quest:3449:completion:2: BGo ahead and toss the flare gun... probably won't be any good to you anymore anyway, and I already got a new one.
rows.quest:3450:details:0: I want the rubbings delivered to my tower, but there's no need to have you go all the way there. I'll just have them air-lifted out of ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:3450:details:1: BXiggs Fuselighter owes me a favor or two and will be in the area soon--he's signed on to patrol the coast. Speak to him before you leave. He can give you a flare gun to signal him with. When you have the rubbings, just head to wherever he tells you and then give them to him so he can get them to my tower safely. He should be in the hangar in the Military Ward.
rows.quest:3450:completion:0: What can I do for you, ⟦18⟧? Kinda busy at the moment preparing my ship for a long trip. I just came over to see some of the tank pilots--I need some wendigo manes to line my cockpit and they usually have extra.
rows.quest:3450:completion:1: BI can give you a minute if you're brief... one of the boys just took off to Steelgrill's Depot to see if the pilots down there have extra manes for me.
rows.quest:3451:obj:0: Speak to Xiggs Fuselighter and get a Standard Issue Flare Gun from him in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:3451:details:0: Ah, so Tymor sent you, huh? Yeah, I owe him a favor or two. What's that? Why, that little devil. Yeah, I can help him out with that. So you'll need a flare gun and a location... easy enough.
rows.quest:3451:details:1: BThere's a small island off the southern peninsula of ⟦E19⟧ that we've made a landing pad on. You take this flare gun, and use it there. I'll see your signal and come by to pick up this... whatever it is he wants.
rows.quest:3451:completion:0: Here's my standard issue flare gun, and be patient after you fire off the gun--there are only a couple charges in one of these, and it might take me a minute to get to you depending on how far out to sea I am. Just look out to sea after you fire off the flare.
rows.quest:3461:obj:0: Return Tymor's Drawing Kit to him in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:3461:details:0: Tymor didn't give me anything to pay you with, so I suggest you take it up with him when you get back to ⟦E1⟧. I'm sure he'll still be in his place in the Mystic Ward. Just go knockin' and make sure he pays you good. This place ain't no picnic... that's for sure.
rows.quest:3461:details:1: BThanks again for helping him out though, and good luck.
rows.quest:3461:details:2: BOh, and I don't need the drawing kit. Why don't you just bring it back to Tymor when you go to see him?
rows.quest:3461:completion:0: Wonderful! I'm so glad to hear it.
rows.quest:3461:completion:1: BI'm really excited to get to my tower and go over those rubbings. I'm so envious of you... going to a place like ⟦E19⟧. That's any student of the arcane's dream, I would guess.
rows.quest:3461:completion:2: BWell, we never spoke about any kind of reward since you were just working for the Explorer's League, but you deserve something.
rows.quest:3701:obj:0: Venture to the Ruins of Thaurissan in the ⟦E21⟧ and recover information from the Thaurissan Relics. Return to Royal Historian Archesonus when you have recovered the information.
rows.quest:3701:details:0: Venture to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan in the ⟦E21⟧ and gather as much information as possible.
rows.quest:3701:details:1: BIt is said that mysterious relics litter the ruins. Perhaps you should start your search there, ⟦19⟧. Beware the Thaurissan guardians: Assassins that guard the ruins, keeping whatever secrets may still be buried there protected.
rows.quest:3701:completion:0: Oh my! This information explains quite a lot about Thaurissan.
rows.quest:3701:completion:1: BThere is much more to learn!
rows.quest:3702:obj:0: Listen to Royal Historian Archesonus recant the history of Thaurissan.
rows.quest:3702:details:0: Would you like to hear a brief history of the Dark Iron dwarves?
rows.quest:3790:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E9⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:3790:details:0: Excuse me ⟦20⟧, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.
rows.quest:3790:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle in ⟦E10⟧ is looking for seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Arch ⟦E9⟧ Fandral Staghelm is spearheading this research.
rows.quest:3790:details:2: BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly in the Cenarion Enclave within ⟦E10⟧ proper.
rows.quest:3790:completion:0: Well now, ⟦21⟧... since you were informed that I was leading this research myself, you obviously came as quickly as you could.
rows.quest:3790:completion:1: BNow that you are here, be sure to pay attention the first time I tell you the details; I have no desire to repeat myself.
rows.quest:4512:obj:0: Bring 6 Filled Cursed Ooze Jars and 6 Filled Tainted Ooze Jars to Laris Geardawdle in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4512:details:0: But the thing I've studied most is ooze. I know it sounds odd, but they're all over!
rows.quest:4512:details:1: BI helped a lady in Menethil find her bag not too long ago--it was eaten by oozes. I've seen members of the Royal Apothecary Society from ⟦E22⟧ collecting samples of the stuff. I want to know why! Where does it come from?
rows.quest:4512:details:2: BI've heard of more in ⟦E23⟧. What I need are samples of the oozes there so I can further my research. I'll give you containers, you use them to collect a sample from the deceased creatures.
rows.quest:4512:completion:0: Amazing results, ⟦22⟧! You got close enough to take a sample of the corrupted things, and managed to look no worse for wear! Thank you. Oh, these samples will be perfect. I can't wait to start testing on them.
rows.quest:4512:completion:1: BIf I'm right, I could be one of the Explorers' Leagues greatest scientists!
rows.quest:4512:completion:2: BThat'll prove to all the dwarves that it wasn't a mistake to allow us gnomes into ⟦E1⟧ after the Gnomeregan incident.
rows.quest:4513:obj:0: Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to Laris Geardawdle in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4513:obj:1: BIf you have trouble finding them, perhaps try to get more clues from Laris.
rows.quest:4513:details:0: I'm going to need more samples, ⟦23⟧. But--and I don't know how to put this--they have to be pure samples. I know, I know. "What does 'pure' mean, Laris?" I'm not sure. I do know that these are corrupt... just like ⟦E23⟧. Which is what makes my realization so important. The oozes seem to adapt... to take on the aspects of the area they're in. I'll need to find samples that haven't been polluted. But where? Where?!
rows.quest:4513:details:1: BBah! ⟦24⟧, take these containers just in case you find any on your own.
rows.quest:4513:completion:0: You've found it? ⟦25⟧, you are a treasure unto yourself. Your dedication and aid has been magnificent and I could not possibly thank you enough.
rows.quest:4513:completion:1: BPlease, take this for your troubles. I have some work to do, but I'm sure, if you come back at a later time, I'll have need of your services again.
rows.quest:4513:completion:2: BThank you. Thank you so much.
rows.quest:5090:obj:0: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the ⟦E24⟧.
rows.quest:5090:details:0: Hear ye, hear ye! All heroes are called upon to heed these words!
rows.quest:5090:details:1: BA call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of ⟦E17⟧! All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the ⟦E25⟧! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the ⟦E26⟧!
rows.quest:5090:details:2: BHeroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the ⟦E24⟧!
rows.quest:5090:completion:0: Welcome to the ⟦E26⟧, hero. This is one of most dangerous frontiers in ⟦E5⟧, especially with the looming threat of the Scourge to our north and northeast. I am glad to hear that the clarion call of duty and service to the greater good did not fall on deaf ears with you!
rows.quest:5090:completion:1: BIf you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the ⟦E26⟧.

rows.quest:7905:obj:0: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival.
rows.quest:7905:details:0: The Darkmoon Faire is coming! Be sure to experience all the wonders and excitement of it when it comes to town!
rows.quest:7905:details:1: BIf you act right now, you can redeem this voucher for free prize tickets! Just hand your voucher to Gelvas Grimgate located inside the carnival.
rows.quest:7905:details:2: BRight now, the Faire is outside Goldshire, in the ⟦E27⟧. Don't miss out! Go today!
rows.quest:7905:completion:0: Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire! This voucher is good for FIVE, yes, FIVE prize tickets!
rows.quest:7905:completion:1: BWhen you accumulate prize tickets, you'll want to speak to me about redeeming them for valuable prizes. The more tickets you get, the more prizes you can win. Huzzah!
rows.quest:8275:obj:0: Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E28⟧.
rows.quest:8275:details:0: Attention, heroes of the ⟦E2⟧! The silithid menace has been left unchecked for too long. Unfettered by any real opposition, they've been preparing all this time for a large-scale expansion.
rows.quest:8275:details:1: BCenarion Circle forces are gathering in ⟦E28⟧ to take the fight to these wretched creatures and all able-bodied adventurers are hereby called to join us!
rows.quest:8275:details:2: BDon't wait until it's too late! Aid us in the defense of ⟦E5⟧! Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold for specific instructions!
rows.quest:8275:completion:0: Excellent, a new recruit answering the call to arms against the silithid. Welcome to Cenarion Hold, ⟦32⟧. I am pleased to see the words of our emissaries are reaching heroes of your caliber. You will find no shortage of opportunities to help us in our efforts here and I expect you'll quickly prove to be a valuable ally to our cause.
rows.quest:8371:obj:0: Bring 3 ⟦E29⟧ Mark of Honor, 3 ⟦E30⟧ Mark of Honor and 3 ⟦E31⟧ Mark of Honor to an ⟦E2⟧ Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
rows.quest:8371:details:0: We're not fighting isolated battles against the ⟦E32⟧ anymore, ⟦33⟧.
rows.quest:8371:details:1: BVictory in one front means denying the ⟦E32⟧ resources they'd use against us in a different battle. By the same token, losing any given battle could give the advantage to our opponent somewhere else around the world.
rows.quest:8371:details:2: BThe ⟦E2⟧ is in need of more combatants with this sort of worldly understanding... truly seasoned veterans! ⟦34⟧, come back to me after you've served against the ⟦E32⟧ at all of our active battlegrounds.
rows.quest:8371:completion:0: You're not one to disappoint, ⟦35⟧! What you've learned goes beyond petty medals and commendations. What you've learned is what can only come with experience and the hardening of one's temper in the field of battle.
rows.quest:8371:completion:1: BYou've done well, ⟦36⟧. You're a true hero of the ⟦E2⟧!
